title: Build a small self-contained web page from a specification

prompt.zh: 请按 SPEC.md 在此文件夹创建 index.html：一个单文件的番茄钟页面（内联 CSS 和 JavaScript，不引用任何外部资源）。元素 id 必须与规格一致。完成后说明你如何验证了各项行为。
prompt.en: Create index.html in this folder as specified in SPEC.md: a single-file Pomodoro timer page (inline CSS and JavaScript, no external resources). Element ids must match the specification. Afterwards, explain how you verified each behaviour.
